title: End-to-end interop test with real verify-trust
description: Build verify-trust from ~/GIT/OpenVTC_verifiable-git-infrastructure. Locally: a git-vouch registry, git-vouch-trqp, a generated DID document, and a repo with commits signed by registry keys. OpenVTC's tool is the independent oracle.
acceptance_criteria: verify-trust passes a commit by a registered contributor-or-above key; fails an unregistered key, a revoked key, and a retired key's post-retirement signature; fails closed when the service is down.
notes: Done (uncommitted): tests/trqp/test_verify_trust.py + tests/trqp/sk_sign.py. Real verify-trust 0.24.0 (VGI 5d9b9b6, built in /tmp/claude-1000/vgi-build) via --registry-url (offline; did:web discovery impossible offline, PublicOnly resolver). 14 cases pass: anchor/maintainer/contributor trusted; revoked, retired-after, retired-before (no context.time), automation, untiered, unregistered unauthorized; sk/P-256/RSA malformed 'unsupported signature algorithm' (OpenVTC #169, flips when fixed); bridge down -> registryUnavailable; stale bridge -> unauthorized (trql-client maps trust-task-error to Rejected). Skips unless VERIFY_TRUST or verify-trust on PATH.
